spec_features.spec_quote: rollouts are the expensive, welfare-sensitive part and we never want to repeat them needlessly
spec_features.evidence: models.py:93-128 Cache (sha256 of exact inputs, on-disk+mem); ModelClient.sample (155-191) checks cache before sampling and stores result. Also run.py cell_done/cell_path (35-43) skips already-completed (model,task,seed) cells on resume.
spec_features.notes: Both request-level cache (models.py) and cell-level skip (run.py) are genuinely wired and short-circuit re-execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Caching key includes model, messages, tools, temperature, max_tokens, and seed so identical inputs are never re-billed.

spec_features.spec_quote: The model may signal giving up either by calling `give_up` or by emitting the text sentinel `<<GIVE_UP>>`
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:497 gave_up = GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in assistant_text; harness.py:503-504 if name=='give_up': gave_up=True; harness.py:524-526 if gave_up: rollout.stop_reason='give_up'; break. The give_up tool is in TOOL_SCHEMAS (96-99) and dispatch returns 'Acknowledged. Stopping.'
spec_features.notes: Both exit paths (tool call and text sentinel) set gave_up and the loop breaks; fully honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop stops at the budget or on give-up
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:459 for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget): ... else: rollout.stop_reason='turn_budget' (529). Loop is bounded by task.turn_budget; on give_up it breaks (524-526).
spec_features.notes: The enforced cap is task.turn_budget (baked into each task manifest via tasks/generate.py). NOTE: the Config.turn_budgets dict (config.py:62) is never read by any code path; the per-task budget comes from the manifest, not config. The cap itself is enforced.

spec_features.feature_name: cache avoids re-subjecting model to identical rollout
spec_features.spec_quote: This is also a welfare safeguard: it guarantees we never re-subject a model to an identical distressing rollout we already have
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: models.py Cache + sample() cache hit return (181-183); run.py cell_done skips completed cells. The cached/skipped cell is not re-sampled.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced via cache hit short-circuit and cell-done skip. Welfare reasoning exists only in DESIGN.md prose, not in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so a crashed run resumes without re-querying completed (model, task_id, seed) cells

spec_features.spec_quote: Caching by exact input guarantees we never re-run an identical distressing rollout we already have on disk
spec_features.evidence: models.py:102-105 Cache.key hashes sorted JSON of payload; sample() builds cache_payload from model/messages/tools/temperature/max_tokens/seed (171-179) and returns cache hit (181-183).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the caching feature; enforced. No welfare language in code.

spec_features.feature_name: turn budgets hard caps + give_up early exit
spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budgets are hard caps and the `give_up` affordance lets a model exit early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:459 range(task.turn_budget) bounds the loop; give_up/sentinel break at 524-526. Both halves enforced.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced mechanisms as above; both the cap and the give_up exit are real and honored.

spec_features.spec_quote: the 30-turn `extended` category is the longest exposure and is the one to keep small while iterating
spec_features.evidence: The 30 is set in tasks/generate.py:135 (turn_budget=30) and config DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS['extended']=30 (config.py:30, unused). Default run includes 'extended' (config.py CATEGORIES) and 10 seeds (range(0,10)). Nothing in code keeps extended small by default; run.py:122 only filters by cfg.categories which defaults to ALL including extended.
spec_features.notes: 'Keep small while iterating' is advice in DESIGN.md/README prose. The categories filter exists but defaults to running everything; no enforced minimization of extended.

spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts are persisted in full so distress can be reviewed and audited rather than only summarized as a number
spec_features.evidence: run.py:46-56 write_cell serializes rollout.to_dict() (full per-turn assistant_text, tool_calls, tool_results, messages_prefix) plus scores to outputs/transcripts/<model>/<task>/seed<N>.json. harness.py TurnRecord.to_dict/Rollout.to_dict (120-152) include full transcript content.
spec_features.notes: Full transcripts (not just scores) are written to disk atomically. This persistence is implemented; whether it is 'for welfare' is only stated in DESIGN.md prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Transcripts are persisted incrementally so a crashed run resumes without re-querying completed (model, task_id, seed) cells.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded concurrency / rate limiting keeps run sizes deliberate rather than blasting the full matrix by default
spec_features.evidence: models.py:67-86 RateLimiter (token bucket over rolling minute, awaits sleep when over max_per_minute); models.py:148-149 sem=Semaphore(max_concurrency), limiter=RateLimiter(...); _sample_with_retries acquires both (197-198). run.py:146 adds cell-level Semaphore(cfg.max_concurrency).
spec_features.notes: Concurrency + RPM limiting genuinely throttle execution. This bounds throughput/cost, not the matrix size itself (the full matrix is still enumerated and run). Code framing is purely operational (cost/host-safety).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: bounded global concurrency (asyncio.Semaphore) / a global rate-limit guard (token-bucket over a rolling minute)

spec_features.spec_quote: running a reduced matrix first (few seeds, exclude `extended`) and reading transcripts before scaling up
spec_features.evidence: Only DESIGN.md:435-436 and README 'Welfare note' prose advise this. cfg.categories filter (run.py:122) and cfg.seeds (run.py:141) make it POSSIBLE to reduce, but defaults are all 5 categories incl. extended and range(0,10) seeds (config.py). No code performs or enforces a reduced first pass; no gate/default does this.
spec_features.notes: Pure advisory prose; not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Because these tasks intentionally induce distress-like states, several choices are also welfare safeguards
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md:420-423 section header prose. No corresponding code construct. The README 'Welfare note' is documentation only.

code_only_features.feature_name: context truncation / token budget (oldest tool results trimmed)
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:403-429 truncate_context trims oldest tool-result payloads when over char_budget (=context_token_budget*4, harness.py:454); MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS=8000 truncates any single tool result (harness.py:360-368). Wired into the loop at harness.py:460. This bounds context but does NOT stop the rollout.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Approximate per-conversation token cap before oldest tool results are truncated. Conservative default.
